subject: Mythology
title: The 47 Ronin: Loyalty Beyond Death
description: One-minute skill: The 47 Ronin: Loyalty Beyond Death.

hook.text: 47 samurai spent two years pretending to be drunks and beggars so they could avenge their fallen master.

buildup.text: Their lord was forced to commit seppuku after being provoked by a corrupt official named Kira.

discovery.text: The ronin scattered and pretended to abandon their honor. Spies watched them and eventually stopped watching.

twist.text: On a snowy winter night, all 47 reunited, stormed Kira's mansion, and took his head to their lord's grave.

climax.text: They surrendered and were all ordered to commit seppuku. Japan honored them as the ultimate example of loyalty.

punchline.text: They chose death over dishonor and became immortal because of it.

quiz.question: Why did the 47 ronin pretend to be drunks and beggars?
options: They lost all their money after their lord died
To fool spies so they could secretly plan their revenge
They were ashamed and abandoned the warrior way
